verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 7a2a62579a02074e7fdf391f4c56a558740dfbf0 fixes the bounded viewport-only smooth zoom anchor timing reported after the smooth zoom surface lane. Root cause scope was presentation-only: the existing paper page transform already had smooth motion, but the scaled paper footprint owned by the paper shell and paper stack lacked an explicit synchronized zoom-motion contract. Focused RED failed in src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts because the stack and shell did not expose data-zoom-motion="smooth" or CSS transitions for the scaled footprint. Editor commit 5ab09608ce03b9e9da194f80cd367ae3d6180611 added data-zoom-motion="smooth" to PaperPage shell and PaperPageStack, transitioned shell width/height and stack gap/min-height for 160ms/ease, and kept the reduced-motion fallback aligned with the paper transform fallback. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/paperSmoothZoomSurface.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 3 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 88 passed test files, 303 passed tests, and build. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 88 passed test files, 303 passed tests, and build. Browser main evidence on http://127.0.0.1:4001/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend on http://127.0.0.1:4011 confirmed 85% to 95%, shell transition width/height 0.16s/ease, stack transition gap/min-height 0.16s/ease, paper transition transform/box-shadow 0.16s/ease, shell/paper footprintDelta 0, 4 authoring controls still disabled, and 0 console errors. Backend /health still reports production blocked, Editor npm install still reports 5 high severity vulnerabilities, and Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor viewport-only zoom anchor bugfix and does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
